The knockout reproduces the right-sided distribution and, at histology, thickened and narrowed pulmonic leaflets - but the two sources disagree on whether it reproduces a structural malformation at all, which is why this is partial recapitulation rather than recapitulation.
edges.limitations: The delineating cohort states that no overt structural cardiac defects were noted in these mice, only impaired valve function on echocardiography, and calls the human-versus-mouse difference in severity unexplained. The original report's histology does describe narrowed, thickened pulmonic leaflets, so the structural claim is contested rather than absent. Either way the mice show nothing like the atresia, Ebstein's anomaly, right ventricular hypoplasia or fetal loss that dominate the patient series, and a complete null does not model the hypomorphic missense alleles most patients carry.

Which mechanism produces it is unresolved, and the graph draws only the route its source supports: the cohort reports the regurgitation alongside ventricular dilation, so the edge here is functional regurgitation on a dilated annulus. A structural, cushion-derived component is not excluded - the inflow cushions build both atrioventricular valves, and the literature lists the mitral valve among those this disorder affects - but no source attributes this cohort's mitral regurgitation to a developmental valve lesion, so no edge from cushion remodelling is drawn.

nodes.description:
Cardiomyopathy in PLD1 disease is recorded in two forms that must be kept apart. The delineating cohort associated recessive PLD1 variants with isolated neonatal cardiomyopathy - that is, cardiomyopathy without an accompanying structural valve defect - which is why this node is not drawn as a consequence of the valve lesion. Separately, dilated cardiomyopathy with left ventricular enlargement has been reported in older patients who also carry the valve disease, where a contribution from chronic valvular loading cannot be separated from a primary myocardial effect.
Conforms to the primary-insult node of cardiomyopathy_maladaptive_remodeling. The module's generic node lists sarcomere organization alongside muscle contraction; PLD1 is not a sarcomere protein and no source implicates sarcomere assembly here, so only the contraction process is substituted. The module's downstream neurohormonal and remodelling chain is deliberately not reproduced: no source establishes it in PLD1 disease, and conforming further down would assert a cascade this entry cannot cite.
